uniteDbPokemon.notes: Batch-01 mechanics survey used descriptions, true_desc, notes, buffs, cooldowns, levels, and formulas from this public JSON.

passiveEffects.name: Moxie
passiveEffects.originalDescription: When the user deals damage with auto attacks or moves, vibes increase, which increase Attack by 5% per stack up to 3. If no vibes are gained within 3s, they are lost, along with the user's boosted gauge. After evolving into Quaquaval, the next auto attack when vibes are maxed becomes Spinning Edge. Each time Spinning Edge hits opposing Pokémon, the user's movement speed is increased by 15% for 3s, stacking up to 3 times.

normalAttackEffects.name: Attack
normalAttackEffects.originalDescription: The user kicks at opposing Pokémon dealing damage. Becomes a boosted attack every third attack, with the user stepping in for a kick with increased damage. Spinning Edge deals damage 3 times in an area around the user over time, before rapidly dealing damage 3 more times. If Low Sweep was used preceding Spinning Edge, then it will do increased damage. If Liquidation was used preceding Spinning Edge, then it will grant a shield on use. If Carnival Splash was used preceding Spinning Edge, it will gain both effects.

uniteMoveEffects.name: Carnival Splash
uniteMoveEffects.originalDescription: The user becomes Unstoppable while dancing in place, gaining a shield and dealing damage to opposing Pokémon up to 3 times. The third hit will pull in opposing Pokémon towards the user, stunning them for 1s. Each opposing Pokémon pulled in grants the user a shield, up to 3 times. The third hit of this move will not affect wild Pokémon. Unite buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% CDR, 20% Max HP Shield
